title: An interrupted outside batch resumes exactly once from adoption to verified merge
body:
Astra audit top-1 (C4 verified; live recovery unverified): an interrupted outside batch cannot resume from the last verified head exactly once; three readers decide whether a lane finished.
Files: evals/adoption/recovery.ts, src/cli/lane-run/drain.ts
Outcome: node evals/adoption/recovery.ts --live recovers an interrupted batch on an authorized outside repository, merges each task exactly once and passes independent acceptance on each merged SHA.
Proof: node evals/adoption/recovery.ts --live prints PASS with one merge per task.
